# namespace_github_base_images (Data Source)

Queries official Namespace Cloud runner base images with optional label and release stage filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

data "namespace_github_base_images" "linux" {
  labels = ["ubuntu-24.04"]
}

output "available_images" {
  value = [for img in data.namespace_github_base_images.linux.images : img.image_ref]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `labels` (List of String) Optional list of runner labels to filter base images by.
- `release_stages` (List of String) Optional list of release stages to filter by (`STAGE_UNKNOWN`, `PRODUCTION`, `CANARY`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier for this data source.
- `images` (Attributes List) List of matching runner base images sorted deterministically by label. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `image_ref` (String) Canonical container image reference.
- `label` (String) Runs-on label identifier (e.g. `ubuntu-24.04`, `macos-15`).
- `spec` (Attributes) Detailed base image specification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images--spec))
- `title` (String) Human-readable title (e.g. `Ubuntu 24.04 LTS`).

<a id="nestedatt--images--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images.spec`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the base image.
- `id` (String) Base image unique identifier.
- `os` (String) Compute OS family (`linux`, `macos`).
- `os_build` (String) OS build identifier.
- `os_name` (String) Human-friendly OS distribution name.
- `os_version` (String) OS distribution version.
- `packages` (Attributes List) Pre-installed software packages included in this base image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images--spec--packages))
- `release_stage` (String) Release stage (`STAGE_UNKNOWN`, `PRODUCTION`, `CANARY`).

<a id="nestedatt--images--spec--packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images.spec.packages`

Read-Only:

- `build` (String) Package build number.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this version is the default.
- `name` (String) Package name (e.g. `Docker`, `Rust`, `Xcode`).
- `type` (String) Package installation type (e.g. `system`, `simruntime`).
- `version` (String) Package version.
